resource_lock_policy: At most one active probe per physical node.  A node-level lock covers both CPU and GPU resources, so CPU resident probes never overlap with GPU ETA probes on the same host.  Homogeneous equivalent nodes are used only for equivalence validation unless explicitly selected as a spillover lane.
